knowledge.title_en: How Spot Bitcoin ETF Inflows Reach the Market
knowledge.body_en:
A spot Bitcoin ETF does not buy coins when you buy shares. Investors trade shares on an exchange; when demand pushes the share price above the fund's net asset value, authorized participants (large broker-dealers) create new shares by delivering cash or bitcoin to the issuer, then sell those shares to capture the gap. Redemptions work in reverse when shares trade at a discount.

Reported daily flows are therefore the net of creations and redemptions, not retail order tickets. They lag price by a day or more, so flows usually confirm a move rather than lead it. A streak of creations does mean real bitcoin is being pulled into custody, tightening float on exchanges.
knowledge.why_en: Last week's $2.4 billion of creations turned 2026 ETF flows positive while BTC rose 4%, a sign the bid is arriving through the arbitrage channel.
